messages.content:
Reply with one JSON object only, matching this JSON schema:
{"$defs": {"AltText": {"properties": {"file": {"description": "photo file name, unchanged", "type": "string"}, "text": {"description": "what the photo shows, for a blind shopper", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["file", "text"], "type": "object"}, "ColourName": {"properties": {"code": {"description": "variant code, unchanged", "type": "string"}, "name": {"description": "the colour name in the listing's language", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["code", "name"], "type": "object"}}, "properties": {"title": {"description": "under 80 characters", "type": "string"}, "bullets": {"description": "3-5 short selling points, facts only", "items": {"type": "string"}, "type": "array"}, "description": {"description": "2-3 sentences", "type": "string"}, "colours": {"description": "one entry per variant code", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/ColourName"}, "type": "array"}, "safety_warnings": {"description": "every safety warning; empty if none", "items": {"type": "string"}, "type": "array"}, "alt_texts": {"description": "one entry per photo file listed", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/AltText"}, "type": "array"}}, "required": ["title", "bullets", "description", "colours", "safety_warnings", "alt_texts"], "type": "object"}
